person.persName: dge slong blo ldan shes rab
rngog dge slong blo ldan shes rab
person.note:
See [BAQ9MH4T]: 193 for the main events of his life.
Three manuscript editions of his writings and translations were deposited respectively in rNgog Blo ldan shes rab's tomb, in the monastery of gSang phu (probably in the main assembly hall), and in Drin las kyi sde (ID:4357) ([7FZ3B926]: 107).

person.persName: zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma
zhang tshes spong chos kyi bla ma
tshes spong ba chos kyi bla ma
zhang tshe spong pa chos kyi bla ma
ne'u thog pa chos kyi bla ma
person.note: Third abbot of gSang phu ne'u thog monastery. Author of several commentaries, see [R894SIKE]: 405 (zhang tshe spong ba chos kyi bla mas kyang TI ka 'ga' re brtsams). Part of the group of the four main disciples of rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786) exX0032026-09-0202-25-28 .

Further holy places associated to him are: Ze thang, Grwa thang and rMog po ([647FFPZR]: 545, based on [Q3KCZX7B]: 38). Remembered for thirteen distinguished objects (such as royal insignia and religious articles), which could be objects of his clan ([4LDAV8UH]: 95.).

person.persName: phywa pa chos kyi seng ge
phya pa chos seng ge ba
dge' slong chos kyi seng ge
dge bshes chen po phya pa chos kyi seng ge
slob dpon phya pa chos kyi seng ge
slob dpon cha pa chos kyi seng ge
rigs pa'i dbang phyug phya pa
rigs pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi seng ge
mkhas pa chen po cha pa
person.note:
The majority of the information available on Phya pa has been provided in [EZ5JXHJY] and [8S7FDMCJ]. Summaries of the same are also found in [LQZU66YX]: 37-40, [F4UK2S8P]: 2-3, and [BW9UR427]: 35-36 (in French).
On his birth in 1109, the year of rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786)'s passing, see [TM8DW8WA]: 32-33, [VKBZTBWN]: 4b4-5, and [8GL7ZT7Y]: 15b2-3. On the date of his passing in a "sa mo glang" year, see [R894SIKE]: 400, [VKBZTBWN]: 4b4-5 and 6a5. [95UZA9Y5]: 40/3/5 (reported in [7FZ3B926]: 111 and [MPRU5QUC]: 206) specifies the day "sa mo glang gi lo'i nag pa zla ba nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad," i.e., on the 23rd of the third month.
A list of his students is provided in [EZ5JXHJY]: 356, based on [MQB8JGAX]: 297/4, [KL9XTQWI]: I, 454, [4YEPFBIB]: 340-341, [8GL7ZT7Y], fol. 15b3, [VKBZTBWN], fol. 4b7-5a4. [FDEWZ2NZ]: 290 also mentions the list of the four "jo sras" from bSod nams dpal's Bla ma rngog pa yab sras rim par byon pa’i rnam thar rin po che’i rgyan gyi phreng ba.
'Gos lo tsa ba lists numerous works composed before Phya pa took the see of gSang phu; these include commentaries and summaries on the Five works of Maitreya, the Pramāṇaviniścaya, the Satyadvayavibhaṅga, Madhyamakālaṃkāra, Madhyamakāloka, and Bodhicaryāvatāra. He mentions having seen these, the Yid kyi mun sel (ID:4503) and summaries on Madhyamaka, as well as (ID:4505) and (ID:5971). See exX0032026-04-2304-02-58 . 'Gos lo tsa ba does not mention any composition dealing with monastic discipline.
Śākya mchog ldan ([TM8DW8WA], 12-13 and 32) mentions a (doubtful) commentary on the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772) in addition to the commentary on the Pramāṇaviniścaya, and three summaries (small, intermediate, large), the intermediate one being the Yid kyi mun sel (ID:4503). (Discussed in [EZ5JXHJY]: 357, translated in [8S7FDMCJ]: 59).
Four groups of students are mentioned in Tibetan sources (which do not imply that the members of the respective groups were studying with Phya pa at the same time), with occasional variations:
1) The "Eight Great Lions" (seng chen brgyad). Eight scholars whose names contains the expression "seng ge," likely connoting their expertise in epistemology. The standard list includes gTsang nag pa (ID:3839), Dan 'bag (ID:3840), 'Bru sha (ID:3841), rMa bya (ID:3842), rTsags/rTsegs (ID:4289), Myang/Nyang bran (ID:3844), and gNyal pa/dMyal ma (ID:6679). The eighth one is instead sometimes said to be gTsang pa 'Jam dpal (ID:6336), 'U yug pa (ID:3846), or mTshur ston (DI:4315).
2) The "four sons of noble families" (jo sras mi bzhi) or the "three sons of noble families" (jo sras gsum). They are young noble men of the rNgog (ID:3847), 'Khon (ID:3848), Khu (ID:3849), and gNyos/sMyos (ID:3850). The four are listed in [VKBZTBWN]: 4a7 and [8GL7ZT7Y]: 15b3, whereas on 16a1 the author speaks of "jo sras gsum." The four are also listed by bSod nams dpal, see [FDEWZ2NZ]: 290.
3) The "three wise ones" (shes rab can mi gsum) or "four wise ones" (shes rab can mi bzhi). The threefold-list in [VKBZTBWN]: 5a1 has rKong po (ID:3852), lHo pa sgom gzan (ID:3853), Par bu ba/sPar phu ba (ID:3854). 'Gar dbang grub (ID:3851) is added in the fourfold list, e.g. in [R894SIKE]: 406.
4) The "three accomplished ones" (grub thob mi gsum). These are students who later became famous masters: Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), Phag mo gru pa (ID:3856), gSal sto (ID:3857). The third is sometimes replaced by Zhang tshal (ID:6409), or is suggested to be the latter's direct student.

rigs par smra ba'i dge slong brtson 'grus seng ge
shag kya'i dge slong brtson 'grus seng ge
slob dpon grags pa'i dbang phyug gtsang nag pa
person.note: Van der Kuijp ([H9MPLMTV]) proposed the dates (?-1185). The terminus ante quem for gTsang nag pa's death was pushed to 1192 by Schwabland ([Q8WU9EDW]: 794, n. 3) on account of the date of Khro pu lo tsA ba (ID:3878)'s studies with gTsang nag pa. This date was corrected to 1195 based on Khro phu lo tsA ba's biography (van der Kuijp, personal communication).

person.persName: gnyal zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
gnyal pa zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
dmyal zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
yul dbus kyi slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rje
person.note: Fl. late 12th to early 13th c. [MPRU5QUC] records the name of this abbot as "'Jam dpal seng ge." He received the name "'jam pa'i rdo rje" during a tantric initiation ([5632TFMN]: 312 and n. 11). [AT6DUUJJ]: 23 discusses his dates, suggesting he lived towards the end of the 12th century.. [5632TFMN]: 313 suggests he may have passed away in ca. 1227.

ab.seg:
phya na re rgan rgon 'chi ka ma'i rig pa lasogs chos can | rig tsam phyi ma skyed nus te | rig tsam yin pa'i phyir | da ltar rig pa 'di bzhin no || zhes pa'i rjes
dpag gis 'grub po zer ba la |

gtsang nag pa na re | des la khyab pa nges byed kyi tshad mas rig tsam la rig pa phyi ma skyed nus te rig pa phyi ma thug med skyes nus kyis khyab pa × grub paM skad cig tsam | dang po ltar na bsgrub bya grub zin pas rtags don med la | gnyis pa ltar na de brgya
'thud kyang skad cig brgya las med pas des de brtan par mi 'grub po || 'di ni rang rig mngon sum gyis thug pa mngon sum gyis thug pa dngos su khegs pas thug med du shugs la 'grub zer ro || de dang 'thun par dmyal pas kyang ngo ||

slob dpon gtsang drug na re ¦ rig tsam la rig pa
phyi ma skyed nus mthong tsam gyi de de'i rang bzhin can du 'grub na ¦ byas yod la 'jig pa mthong tsam gyis kyang de de'i de can du 'grub par thal lo || 'dod na ltos med don med du 'gyur ro || skye 'jig tshul mtshungs pas 'dir yang ¦ rig pa la mthong pa'i rig pa phyi ma bskyed nus chos can ¦
rig tsam dang rang chas rjes su 'brel pa'i rang bzhin yin te ¦ rig tsam phyi ma skyed de rig tsam gyi rgyu las rgyu gzhan la ltos pa med pa'i phyir ro || ces pa ltos med kyi rtags la bsten pa'i rjes dpag gis bdag cig pa'i 'brel pa nges so gsung ngo ||

phya'i la'ang gtsang nag gi de bzlog bsla ste | du ba la me ldan sgrub pa'ang la'i me 'am ¦ la ma yin gyi me zhes brtags na me tsam mo zhes smra dgos pa ltar ¦ 'dir yang rig pa bskyed nus tsam gyis khyab pa grub po zhes smras pas chog go || 'di ni lung khas len pa la lung
gis grub po zhes bya'o ||

gnyal pa na re | dgos med kyi bstan bcos la | 'dod bya ma yin pa dang 'brel med dgos pa la | bsgrub mi nus gang zag bstan bcos brjod bya gsum ka la 'gog zer ba la | phyi ma gnyis mi 'thad de | de 'gog gi
ngag gnyis chos can dgag mi nus par thal | bstan bcos 'dis dgos pa de bsgrub mi nus sam | dgos pa 'di bstan bcos 'di dang ma 'brel lam zhes gnyis ka la zhugs pa la | khyed bsgrub mi nus gang zag bstan bcos brjod bya gsum ka la 'gog cing 'brel med kyi log rtogs
dgos pa nyid kyi steng du 'gog pa'i phyir ro ||

slob dpon gtsang drug na re | brtsod pa'i rtags dang po ma grub | gnyis pa ni snod bcas brdzun pa'i yul can yin pa'i phyir gyis rtags ma grub | brdzun pa la rdzun par shes pa'i phyir | 'khrul par thal ba ma nges so ||

'bre na re dngos kyi dmigs pa byang chub dang ched du bya ba'i dmigs pa gzhan don de ni shes par bya'o || gong ltar na mdo bzhin du'o || mdo las ji skad bshad na bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod ces zer |

dang po la btsad pa ni brjod par rigs tshul 'dra ba la | brjod tshul la 'bre la sogs pa rnams na re dmigs pa dang po ma gtogs
pas chos 'ba' zhig brjod pas | dmigs pa bcu gcig skyon can gzhan skyon med do zer ro || gnal pa de las bzlog nas nyer gsum po la can zhes pas gzhung la chad par 'dod do || lugs gsum dgag cing 'thad don brjod ||
'bre na re sgra mi rtag ces sam
sgra'i mi rtag ces pa ni chos brjod dang khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra yin te | chos can sgras khyad par du byas nas chos mi rtag pa brjod pa'i phyir ro || khyab pa'ang sbyor ba skor cig la ltos nas chos la chos can rten par 'gal ba'i phyir ro || mi rtag pa'i sgra byas na chos can brjod pa dang |
khyad par gzhan mi spong pa'i sgra yin te chos des khyad par byas nas chos can sgra brjod pa'i phyir ro || khyab pa'ang sbyor ba skor cig la chos can chos can la chos rten par mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro || gang ltar yang sgra dang mi rtag pa'i tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med do || de bzhin gzugs
sogs 'du 'god med byas na chos brjod kyi sgra | 'du 'god med pa'i gzugs sogs byas na chos can brjod pa'i sgra yin te | de gnyis ka ltar na yang de gnyis kyi tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med do zer ro ||

gnyal pa na re sgra mi rtag byas na chos can brjod pa dang khyad par gzhan mi
spong pa'i sgra yin te | rang gi brjod bya mi rtag pa dang chos du ma'i rten sgra gnyis tha dad du brjod pa'i phyir ro || sgra'i mi rtag byas na cig shos te | de dang de tha dad du brjod pa'i phyir ro || tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad yed 'dra'o || de bzhin du gzugs sogs 'du 'god med zhes dang | gzugs
sogs kyi 'du 'god med ces pa'ang rim bzhin te tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med zer ro ||

slob dpon gtsang drug na re de gnyis chos du ma'i rten yin min bye brag med do || 'di ni sgra mi rtag byas na chos can brjod pa'i sgra mi ldan rnams × gcod kyi sgra yin te | sgra la rtag pa rnam
par bcad pa tsam yin gyi sgra las gzhan mi rtag pa yin pa bsal ba med pa'i phyir ro || sgra'i mi rtag byas na chos brjod pa'i sgra gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyi ngag yin te sgra las gzhi gzhan gyi mi rtag pa bcad nas | sgra kho rang mi rtag pa go byed du byung pa'i phyir ro || de bzhin du
don la sbyor de ma thag pa dang 'dra ste | mi ldan × rnam gcod dang gzhan ldan rnam gcod gnyis ka ltar na yang de gnyis kyi tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med do gsung ngo || 'di la tshogs don rtogs pa khyad med spyir dgag | so sor dgag go || dang po ni chos brjod pa dang chos can
brjod pa gang gis kyang tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med pa'i phyir ro || rkyang pa brjod na ma tshogs pa'i ya gyal go ba med par thal lo || 'dod na des tshogs don rtogs pa'ang med par thal | ya gyal brjod nas go ba khegs pa'i phyir ro || ma nges na mi tsam med kyang
btsun pa yod ces bya'o ||
so sor dgag pa ni 'bre'i de la chos brjod pa dang chos can brjod pa'i khyad par med par thal | brjod pa'i tshe gnyis ka brjod la brjod bya tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro ||

de yang rngog lo ts+tsha ba na re | bka'
thams cad dgongs pa dang | ldem dgongs gnyis su 'dus zer ba 'thad do || rigs kyi dbye ba la brtsod yang 'dir ni rigs tha dad bcu gsum gyi dbye ba rung pa ma yin zhes pa'i brtsod lan du 'thad do || byang se kho na theg chen gyi rigs can ma yin par 'thad pa ni 'dod do ||
'di ni kun 'byung gi go ba la ma mthun pa yin te | 'bre | gsung pa 'thad dam snyam mo ||

a du la na re | byang se'i nyon mongs kyi nus pa bzhi las | 'khor bar skye ba'i nus pa dang | rigs 'dra bskyed pa'i nus pa gnyis mi yong | sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i dang | gnyen po ye shes skye ba'i gags byed pa gnyis
yong zer ro ||

thugs chos nyid la mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa yin gyi gzhan la bzhengs bzhugs yod par 'dod do || med na de mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par mi 'jug
par thal te | 'dod na myang 'das kyi mdo dang 'gal lo || klu grub kyi rtsa bshe las |
'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das ||
gnyis ni yod pa ma yin te ||
'khor ba yongs su shes pa la ||
mya ngan 'das shes rab tu brjod || ces so || rtogs pa la thobs pa zhes rngog lo gsung lo ||

gnyal pa na re srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba rnaM kun kho na'i bye brag tu 'dod cing | srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba tsam cig
sa bcu rgyun tha na yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad de | 'o na rnam sbyor yang sa bcu rgyun tha na yod par thal | srid zhi'i de de na yod pa'i phyir ro ||
